assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone cinematic photorealistic 2D side-scroller game prop sprite.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG background with true alpha. One isolated complete object only. No scene, floor, ground plane, shadows cast onto a backdrop, border, matte color, or painted checkerboard.
Style/medium: cinematic photorealistic asset with rich real material texture, realistic small chips and wear, photographic surface detail. Match the material realism of a moonlit Qinling mountain road and dark brass/steel cavern laboratory; reference environments are STYLE ONLY and must never appear in the image.
Lighting/mood: soft cool light from upper left, subtle depth and moderate exposure so surface details remain readable against a dark game environment. No thick outline.
Composition/framing: straight side-on / front elevation suitable for platformer collisions. Center the complete prop with at least 10 percent clear transparent margin on every side. No perspective ground plane.
Constraints: original design, no people, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no icons, no cartoon, no flat vector, no low-poly. Preserve genuine transparency in final PNG.

Primary request: a broad low naturally collapsed pile of archaeological dry human bones: one small aged ivory skull lying sideways among scattered ribs and femurs. The skull must be small relative to the entire pile. Irregular believable silhouette about 2.4:1 width to height, naturally overlapping bones resting together but absolutely no floor or scenic background.
Materials/textures: dry porous weathered bone with dusty warm ivory and muted gray crevices, anatomically plausible forms. No flesh, no blood, no gore.
